jobs.description:
Do you enjoy keeping machines running smoothly? 
Then this technical challenge might be the perfect fit for you!

For an international chocolate producer, we’re looking for a maintenance technician to support the production department. You’ll be part of a skilled team ensuring the reliability and efficiency of the machinery through preventive maintenance and troubleshooting. You work closely with fellow technicians, line operators, and supervisors, reporting directly to the technical supervisor.

Your mission: keep everything running like a well-oiled machine — literally.
 - Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues on machinery and tools.
 - Perform preventive maintenance on equipment and installations.
 - Assist in machine setups and technical interventions.
 - Contribute to technical improvement projects.
 - Maintain order, cleanliness, and safety according to standards.
 - Follow lockout/tagout procedures during maintenance.
 - Manage production-related side streams (waste, recycling, ...).
 - Participate in internal quality and safety training sessions.
 - Carry out and register required quality inspections.

Are you the hands-on technician we’re looking for? 
Apply today – we’d love to meet you!
- Vaardigheden:
You have a technical secondary diploma (A2).
You have at least 3 years of experience in a production environment.
You have solid knowledge of electromechanics.
You work well independently and as part of a team.
You are accurate, quality-driven, and safety-conscious.
You can set priorities and take initiative.
You work hygienically and pay attention to order and cleanliness.
You’re eager to learn and professional in your communication.
You’re willing to work in a nightshift schedule.
Knowledge of pneumatics and cooling systems is a plus.

- Attesten:
No specific certificates required.

- Opleidingsvereisten:
A2 diploma required (preferably electromechanics).

- Vakkennis:
Experience with industrial machinery, troubleshooting, and preventive maintenance.

- Talenkennis:
Good command of English is required.

For our client, an international organization in Heverlee , we are looking for an experienced Accounts Payable Manager to lead the AP team. In this key role, you will ensure the accurate and timely processing of invoices and payments, maintain compliance with accounting and tax regulations and drive continuous process improvements.

Key Responsibilities :

• Lead, coach, and develop the Accounts Payable team.
• Oversee the end-to-end Accounts Payable process, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and timely execution.
• Coordinate invoice processing, payment runs, and AP-related financial controls.
• Manage monthly closing activities, reconciliations, accruals, and follow-up of outstanding items.
• Ensure compliance with VAT, tax, and internal accounting policies.
• Act as the main point of contact for AP-related matters across multiple stakeholders.
• Identify and implement process improvements, standardization initiatives, and automation opportunities.

• Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, or equivalent through experience.
• Several years of experience in Accounts Payable within a multinational or complex organization.
• Strong SAP knowledge; experience with SAP S/4HANA is a plus.
• Solid understanding of VAT and accounting regulations.
• Proven experience leading and developing teams.
• Analytical, structured, and detail-oriented.Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
• Fluent in English, both written and spoken.
• Interest in process optimization, automation, and digital finance solutions.

Company Activities:

Our client is known for its open and jovial atmosphere, characterized by a genuine worker culture and a sense of humor. The facility, located in a bustling logistics hub, includes warehouses that can experience temperature fluctuations when trucks are docked. They pride themselves on fostering a team-oriented environment where every member contributes to collective success.

Jobomschrijving

Are you looking for an exciting opportunity to join a dynamic team at Site Zeebrugge? Our client is currently seeking Reachtruck Operators who will play a critical role in their logistics operations. As a Reachtruck Operator, you will be responsible for ensuring the smooth movement and storage of goods within the facility.

Key Responsibilities:

• Operate reachtrucks efficiently to pick and transport goods (96% of the time).
• Handle manual tasks with a hands-on mentality, including unloading items that may have fallen.
• Scan racks to ensure accurate inventory tracking before and after moving items.
• Occasionally assist in other tasks such as repositioning racks.

Profile Description:

Our client is looking for candidates who are either experienced Reachtruck Operators or possess a valid reachtruck certificate. You will have the opportunity to earn an internal certificate upon completing their training program. Language proficiency in Dutch, English, or French is required to ensure smooth communication within their multicultural team.

jobs.description:
As an Order To Cash German And English in Nivelles, you will manage customer service activities linked to the order-to-cash process within the Retail industry. You will help ensure customer orders are handled clearly and efficiently in German and English.

Client Details

Our client is a family business operating since many years in the FMCG non Food Sector.

They are located in the Walloon Brabant region.

Description

As an Order To Cash German And English your responsibilities are:

• Process customer orders accurately and keep order information up to date
• Handle customer service queries in German and English, providing clear information on orders
• Follow orders through the order-to-cash process to support timely completion
• Liaise with sales, logistics and finance departments
• Coordinate order-related information with relevant internal contacts
• Check customer and order details to help maintain accurate records
• Resolve routine order issues and communicate updates to customers
• Maintain clear documentation of customer contacts and order actions
• Contribute to a reliable customer service process for the Retail business

A successful Order To Cash German And English should have:

• Ability to communicate clearly in German and English
• A first experience in customer service or order to cash roles is a big plus
• Experience in the retail or hard discount world is a plus (Aldi, Lidl, Kruidvat, Colruyt, ...)
• You are accurate, meticulous and can handle deadlines
• Excellent communication skills with clients, distributors, internal stakeholders, ...
• A team player

Our client, Legend Biotech, based in Zwijnaarde, is a global biotechnology company bringing the innovative CAR-T cell therapy to Ghent. With this, the Legend Biotech team makes a daily difference in the lives of many patients suffering from cancer and other life-threatening diseases.
They are currently in a phase of strong growth and are looking for motivated and dedicated team members.

Jobomschrijving

We are looking for experienced pharmaceutical professionals who want to actively contribute to the future of medicine. This is more than just a job, it is an opportunity to further develop your expertise and grow your career in a dynamic, mission-driven environment focused on patient impact.

If you already have experience in cleanroom operations, pharmaceutical manufacturing or chemical processes, or if you combine a relevant educational background with hands-on experience, we would very much like to hear from you.

Your role and responsibilities;

• Actively participate in aseptic and manual pharmaceutical manufacturing processes.
• Work in cleanroom and laboratory environments in accordance with GMP standards.
• Perform production activities in controlled environments (Grade A/B/C/D), including spiking, media exchanges, cell culture activities and freezing of therapeutic products.
• Execute thorough cleaning and disinfection of materials and equipment.
• Support transitions between production zones, ensuring compliance and continuity.

This role is suited for you if you:

• Have relevant pharmaceutical experience or a Bachelor’s degree in Life Sciences.
• Have experience in a cleanroom, pharmaceutical, or chemical environment.
• Enjoy working in a structured environment and following procedures.
• Communicate fluently in English.
• Live near Zwijnaarde and can commute independently to the site.

Senior Database Administrator 

 

Satellit operates a substantial portfolio of mobility assets across multiple European markets and is accelerating its shift toward digital services to improve the customer experience. To support this journey we are hiring a senior database administrator to take responsibility for the current database estate, maintain performance, security and availability, and lead the migration from on-premises data centres to a public cloud environment.
Who are you?

What will you do?

• Deploy, configure, upgrade, administer, monitor and maintain the organisation's relational databases both on-site and in the cloud.

• Define, enforce and document configuration, security and data-integrity standards for databases and related objects; keep operational procedures and technical documentation current.

• Design, implement and operate backup, restore and high-availability arrangements, and coordinate regular disaster-recovery exercises.

• Assess, plan and execute migration of database workloads to a public cloud platform using managed database services, managed instances or database servers on cloud virtual machines, collaborating with cloud engineers.

• Enforce security best practices including least-privilege access, encryption of data at rest and in transit, auditing and patch management.

• Act as a primary responder and escalation point for database incidents and service requests, aiming to minimise downtime and service impact.

• Carry out root-cause investigations for database issues and implement corrective measures to prevent recurrence.

• Review and advise on database schemas and design changes with development teams to ensure scalability, maintainability and security.

• Continuously monitor performance and resource usage, perform query and index optimisation, and forecast capacity and cost implications.

Technologies (mandatory)

• Azure Cloud Platform

• SQL

• Security

• SQL Server

• Postgresql

• Conscientiousness

• Motivation and positive mindset

• Ability to work independently

• Quick learning and strong organizational skills

• Excellent verbal and written communication

• Customer-centric approach

• Teamwork

• Willingness to ask difficult questions

• Professionalism

• Transparency and solution orientation

Preferred Qualifications:

• Minimum seven years of hands-on experience administering databases in production environments where availability and reliability are critical, with deep expertise in mainstream commercial relational database systems.

• Proven experience designing and operating high-availability and disaster-recovery solutions such as synchronous replication and failover clustering.

• Strong proficiency in SQL, including query tuning and execution-plan analysis.

• Practical experience deploying and managing database workloads in a public cloud environment, including managed database offerings and cloud-hosted virtual machines.

• Experience migrating databases from on-premises infrastructure to cloud platforms is highly desirable.

• Familiarity with open-source relational databases is an advantage.

• Ability to automate repetitive tasks using scripting or general-purpose programming languages; experience with infrastructure-as-code or CI/CD for database changes is a plus.

• Track record of leading database projects such as major version upgrades, consolidation initiatives or security-hardening efforts.

• Bachelor's degree in computer science or a related field, or equivalent professional experience; relevant cloud database or IT service-management certifications are beneficial.

• Fluent written and spoken English, plus fluency in either French or Dutch.
